newsitem.title: USA: Ames to finalize $320 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Ames to finalize $320 mln credit facility.

text.p: Ames Department Stores Inc said it expects to finalize its new $320 million revolving credit facility with BankAmerica Business Credit before the end of the year.
The credit facility, which expires in June 2000, includes a $20 million loan portion available for future capital expenditures, the company said.

The credit facility also includes lower interest rates and fees than the company's current credit agreement that will save the company between $3 million and $4 million in interest expense payments during the facility's term.
